answer: The lotus multiplier is published, charged in mirror, and reef lists each payment. A burst of registrations hence prices itself out, because the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The admission burn is multiplied by 19 for each identity already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival forfeits the most. A farm of 4675 identities would post 3580 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
